scope_of_deliverables.value: CMHC is seeking to confirm and implement an operating model for Reference Data Management (RDM) to enhance data governance and capabilities. The work is divided into three streams: 1) Develop and Implement an Operating Model for RDM, 2) Adoption of RDM Governance and Policy, and 3) Implement a Sustainable Technical Solution.
scope_of_deliverables.quote: CMHC is seeking qualified companies through this Request for Proposal (RFP) to confirm and implement an operating model for data management capabilities, specifically Reference Data Management (RDM). This initiative aims to enhance CMHC’s data governance and RDM capabilities, supporting compliance, operational efficiency, and strategic objectives.

pricing_structure.value: Pricing is worth 20 points of the total score. Pricing will be scored based on a relative pricing formula using the rates set out in the Pricing Form. Each proponent will receive a percentage of the total possible points allocated to price for the particular category it has bid on, which will be calculated in accordance with the following formula: Lowest price ÷ proponent's price x weighting = proponent's pricing points. All prices and amounts of money in the proposal are to be quoted in Canadian dollars and be exclusive of the Goods and Services Tax (GST), Harmonized Sales Tax (HST), and Provincial Sales Tax (PST), as applicable. Rates quoted by the proponent must be all-inclusive and must include all labour and material costs, on-going maintenance costs, all travel and carriage costs, all insurance costs, all costs of delivery, all costs of installation and set-up, and all other overhead.
pricing_structure.quote: Pricing is worth 20 points of the total score. Pricing will be scored based on a relative pricing formula using the rates set out in the Pricing Form. Each proponent will receive a percentage of the total possible points allocated to price for the particular category it has bid on, which will be calculated in accordance with the following formula: Lowest price ÷ proponent's price x weighting = proponent's pricing points. All prices and amounts of money in the proposal are to be quoted in Canadian dollars and be exclusive of the Goods and Services Tax (GST), Harmonized Sales Tax (HST), and Provincial Sales Tax (PST), as applicable, unless otherwise indicated. The GST, HST or PST, whichever is applicable, shall be extra to the price quoted and will be paid by CMHC. Rates quoted by the proponent must be all-inclusive and must include all labour and material costs, on-going maintenance costs, all travel and carriage costs, all insurance costs, all costs of delivery (including any on-boarding/training costs, if not listed separately in the pricing form), all costs of installation and set-up, including any pre-delivery inspection charges, and all other overhead, including any fees or other charges required by law.
